The '''Tx-37''' was a model of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. It preceded the release of the [[XP-38 sport landspeeder]], but many of the Tx-37's design features were included in the later model.<ref name="EGVV" />
